correctness.rationale: For fixed d≥2, Plancherel gives the supremum of the multiplier difference on √t·Z^d, not the L² distance between kernels. At fixed Euclidean radius the signed extrema necessarily use opposite endpoints of the sharp ℓ¹/ℓ² ratio interval: the Poisson-minus-heat maximum uses axes and the heat-minus-Poisson maximum uses equal absolute coordinates. The critical equation h=log(2u/a)+au−u²=0 has exactly two simple roots because h is strictly concave, h(a)=log 2, and the limits at both ends are −∞. The scalar maxima have opposite strictly signed derivatives. Their limits at the two ends follow by bounding the unfavorable wing on u<a or u>a, and testing u=a^(−1/2) on the favorable wing. This gives the unique transverse crossing and its strict increase in error with d; the crossing calibration must tend to zero, since a positive lower bound would force the increasing wing to 1 while the decreasing wing stayed below 1. Rounding on the two special rays costs O_d(t) uniformly on compact calibration intervals by vanishing radial first derivatives. Fixed lattice witnesses at calibrations on either side exclude all escaping minimizers by signed pointwise monotonicity; compactness gives attainment and the nonzero one-sided slopes give an O_d(t) calibration displacement for every minimizer. The direction statement is limiting, not a claim of exactly equal lattice magnitudes at every t. Indeed at fixed integer ℓ¹ radius, negative-wing maximizers concentrate all mass in one coordinate and positive-wing maximizers balance magnitudes to within one. Reviewed RESULT.md lines 13–66, VERIFICATION.md and check.py; the latter compares six sampled dimensions, not six consecutive dimension increments. An independent bounded direct scalar maximization gave (c₂,E₂)≈(0.78155787578,0.20968189592) and (c₃,E₃)≈(0.71242187012,0.24296641228); this is a numerical cross-check only. No uniform-in-d remainder or formal certificate is claimed.

value.rationale: The optimized norm is a concrete measure of whether product-Poisson smoothing can substitute uniformly for heat on L² across frequencies. The sharp positive obstruction, competing explicit worst directions and worsening with dimension are informative beyond a qualitative inequivalence of generators. The stationary O_d(t) control transfers the continuum comparison back to integer modes and specifies the time of every optimum, not just one admissible choice.
